pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'non' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. hello, good day
   C. no
   D. thank you

2. What does 'oui' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. goodbye
   C. Sir, Mr
   D. hello, good day

3. How do you say 'Here is my grandfather.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon père s'appelle David.
   B. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   C. C'est le bébé.
   D. Voici mon grand-père.

4. What does 'le frère' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the boy
   B. the brother
   C. the father
   D. the grandmother

5. What does 'le lit' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cat
   B. the living room
   C. the sofa
   D. the bed

6. What does 'la semaine' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the day
   B. the week
   C. the school
   D. the church

7. How do you say 'On Sunday, I go to church.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   B. Le jeudi, je chante.
   C. Le samedi, je joue.
   D. Le vendredi, je danse.

8. What does 'jeudi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Friday
   C. Sunday
   D. Thursday

9. How do you say 'Thank you very much!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je chante et je danse.
   B. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   C. J'ai dix ans.
   D. Merci beaucoup !

10. What number is 'seize' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 4
   C. 16
   D. 3

11. What number is 'dix-huit' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 31
   C. 7
   D. 8

12. How do you say 'It is not good for your health.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'aime le lait.
   B. Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   C. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   D. C'est un gâteau.

13. What does 'les bonbons' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sweets
   B. fruits
   C. the mango
   D. the cake

14. What does 'la dent' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the ear
   B. the arm
   C. the eyes
   D. the tooth

15. What does 'le genou' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the knee
   B. the finger
   C. the ear
   D. the stomach

16. What does 'Tournez' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Turn
   B. Go
   C. You are welcome
   D. Excuse me

17. How do you say 'Go straight ahead.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il est sur la table.
   B. Le chat est derrière la porte.
   C. La télé est sur la table.
   D. Allez tout droit.

18. How do you say 'Where is the key?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Où est la clé ?
   B. Allez tout droit.
   C. Elle est sous la chaise.
   D. Le lit est dans la chambre.

19. Which little word goes with 'famille' (the family)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. la

20. Which little word goes with 'porte' (the door)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

21. Which day comes before mercredi? (1 mark)
   A. mardi
   B. lundi
   C. jeudi
   D. vendredi

22. Which little word goes with 'gâteau' (the cake)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

23. Which number is trente et un? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 31
   C. 30
   D. 13

24. Which one should we eat only a little? (1 mark)
   A. l'eau
   B. la carotte
   C. les bonbons
   D. le lait

25. What does 'Il est grand.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a mouth.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. She has black hair.
   D. He is tall.

26. Which little word goes with 'pluie' (the rain)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

27. What does 'Tournez à gauche.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Go straight ahead.
   B. Turn left.
   C. You are welcome!
   D. The door is next to the window.

28. What does 'Elle est sous la chaise.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is under the chair.
   B. Where is the key?
   C. You are welcome!
   D. Excuse me, where is the school?

29. How do you say the month 'January' in French? (1 mark)
   A. janvier
   B. avril
   C. juillet
   D. février

30. How do you say 'the leg' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le ventre
   B. la jambe
   C. le dos
   D. le genou

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write two instructions in French to tell a friend where to put a book and a bag. (4 marks) (4 marks)

32. Write the French words for: health, the cake, beans (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Write the French words for: a birthday, a month, a present (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into English: 'Le tapis est devant le canapé.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Write the French words for: Pleased to meet you, Mrs, Madam, thank you (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Write the French words for: pleasant, the snow, strong (3 marks) (3 marks)

37. Draw and label a simple bedroom in words: write the French labels for the bed, the door, the window and the chair. (4 marks) (4 marks)

38. Write the French words for: straight ahead, Excuse me, Go (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Write in French: your birthday is on 25 December. (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Translate into English: 'Demain, il fait beau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Translate into English: 'Elle est petite.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'Here is a present for you.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'It is a cake.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Ma mère s'appelle Grace.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'C'est une table.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'My father is called David.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Je reste dans la maison.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — no
   non means no.

2. A — yes
   oui means yes.

3. D — Voici mon grand-père.
   Here is my grandfather. in French is Voici mon grand-père.

4. B — the brother
   le frère means the brother.

5. D — the bed
   le lit means the bed.

6. B — the week
   la semaine means the week.

7. A — Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   On Sunday, I go to church. in French is Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.

8. D — Thursday
   jeudi means Thursday.

9. D — Merci beaucoup !
   Thank you very much! in French is Merci beaucoup !

10. C — 16
   seize means 16.

11. A — 18
   dix-huit means 18.

12. C — Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   It is not good for your health. in French is Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.

13. A — sweets
   les bonbons means sweets.

14. D — the tooth
   la dent means the tooth.

15. A — the knee
   le genou means the knee.

16. A — Turn
   Tournez means Turn.

17. D — Allez tout droit.
   Go straight ahead. in French is Allez tout droit.

18. A — Où est la clé ?
   Where is the key? in French is Où est la clé ?

19. D — la
   famille is feminine, so we say la famille.

20. C — la
   porte is feminine, so we say la porte.

21. A — mardi
   Tuesday comes before Wednesday.

22. C — le
   gâteau is masculine, so we say le gâteau.

23. B — 31
   Trente is 30 and un is 1.

24. C — les bonbons
   Sweets are not good for health if eaten too often.

25. D — He is tall.
   Il est grand. means He is tall.

26. D — la
   pluie is feminine, so we say la pluie.

27. B — Turn left.
   Tournez à gauche. means Turn left.

28. A — It is under the chair.
   Elle est sous la chaise. means It is under the chair.

29. A — janvier
   January in French is janvier.

30. B — la jambe
   the leg in French is la jambe.

----

   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

34. (3 marks)

   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

35. (3 marks)

36. (3 marks)

   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

37. (4 marks)

38. (3 marks)

39. (3 marks)

40. (3 marks)

41. (2 marks)

44. (3 marks)

45. (2 marks)

46. (3 marks)

47. (3 marks)

   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.
